title: Finalize Payment Tracker App publishing + export full project and problem files

requirements.text: Update all user-facing app naming to consistently use the production name "Payment Tracker App" across the frontend (document title/metadata, login screen branding text and alt text, and in-app header/brand label) and any other visible strings where the old name appears (e.g., "Monthly Payment Tracker", "Payment Tracker", "Finance Tracker").

quotes: Rename this to Payment Tracker App

acceptanceCriteria: Browser tab title shows "Payment Tracker App" (instead of "Monthly Payment Tracker").
Login screen title/branding uses "Payment Tracker App" (instead of "Monthly Payment Tracker").
App header brand label uses "Payment Tracker App" (instead of "Payment Tracker").
No remaining user-visible occurrences of "Finance Tracker" in the frontend README or UI copy.

requirements.text: Add a repo-local export package that contains the full project folder structure snapshot for delivery: create a top-level folder (e.g., "delivery/") with (a) a human-readable tree/index of the project structure and (b) a reproducible script/command documented in that folder that (re)generates the snapshot from the repo sources without manual copying.
acceptanceCriteria: A new top-level delivery folder exists containing an index file that lists the full project folder structure.
Delivery folder includes documented steps to regenerate the export from the repository (single command or clearly ordered steps).
The export content includes both backend and frontend code folders in the structure listing.

requirements.text: Collect "problem files" relevant to diagnosing build/deploy failures into a dedicated subfolder inside the delivery package, and include a short README describing what each collected file is used for and why it is included.

quotes: Okk I need all the problem files in a separate folder and send to me

acceptanceCriteria: A dedicated subfolder exists under the delivery folder (e.g., delivery/problem-files/) containing the selected build/deploy-related config/docs files.
A README in that subfolder lists each included file and its troubleshooting relevance (e.g., env examples, type env declarations, build/deploy docs).

requirements.text: Stabilize and complete the end-to-end publish flow to production on the Internet Computer by identifying and fixing deterministic causes of the intermittent build/deploy failure so consecutive deployments can complete reliably (frontend build, canister build, deploy).

quotes: Deployment/build process is failing intermittently ("hit a snag" / language model error), preventing successful deploy.

acceptanceCriteria: A full build and deploy can be executed end-to-end without intermittent failures caused by missing configuration, type errors, or dependency issues.
A short deployment troubleshooting note is added to documentation (or delivery notes) describing what was fixed and how to reproduce a successful deploy.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional backend services.

Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or any files in frontend/src/components/ui; compose or wrap instead.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding new product functionality beyond publishing/exporting (e.g., bank connections, automatic imports, budgeting features).
Introducing third-party authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
Adding external databases or non-Motoko backend services.
